propositions: Advisory finding text is never rendered on Gerrit changes; only a count of findings is published in the review message
The adapter._summarize PASS branch publishes len(verdict['advisory']) as a bare count instead of enumerating finding details
Finding location field is discarded by _translate_findings before reaching Gerrit, preventing any file/line anchoring
Robot comments are unsupported on this Gerrit server, making the review message body the only proven surface for finding visibility
Inline comments are never constructed because post_vote is called with four positional args, leaving robot_comments parameter always defaulted
Advisory findings must be enumerated in the review message body on both PASS and BLOCK paths to allow operators to determine which advisories should be promoted to blocking
